description: A configurable 2D game character sprite: an original basic medieval footman matching the provided walk.png style reference: small chibi/isometric RPG sprite, kettle helmet or simple steel cap, chainmail, padded tunic, boots, round shield, short sword, compact readable silhouette, no logo or readable text; directional animations use isometric/angled views, with walk-up as back/top angled walking away and walk-down as front/top angled walking toward camera.
